blockingIssues.description: Remote git ingest still clones with the credentialed source URL before rewriting .git/config, so raw credentials can briefly land on disk during cache creation.
db doctor can under-report an unhealthy DB when config loading fails because it skips index-state inspection and falls back to failed-manifest checks only.
db doctor can crash on an existing DB that lacks index_metadata because read-only stats collection still queries the table without a guard.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that db doctor uses a temporary read-only snapshot copy of index.sqlite plus -wal/-shm sidecars to inspect state without mutating the live project database.
